translations.web: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
translations.bsb: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
translations.kjv: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
translations.asv: Be thou to me a rock of habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: Thou hast given commandment to save me; For thou art my rock and my fortress.
